tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers H ≤ 0.48, far short of the target horizon. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish the recalled reversal and sink-coupled mechanisms and identify their slow dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-exponential adaptation from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short horizons and correlated inputs do not reliably identify slow adaptation or distinguish the candidate mechanisms at H = 21.9.
Finer short-horizon measurements would be less directly informative about the long-horizon reversal.
It is irrelevant to the identified long-horizon ambiguity.
